summary: CoreAudioKit is the view layer for Audio Unit plugin UIs, Bluetooth and network MIDI/audio device pickers and inter-app audio widgets. BifrOSt has no Audio Unit host and no AU view API; its audio service and Bluetooth module cover playback routing and device status but none of the CoreAudioKit views.

features.feature: Audio unit custom UI (view controller, view configuration, generic view)
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/param_view.rs; wired: springboard/apps/daw/src/rack.rs (slider mapping over springboard/ui/src/param_view.rs)
features.note: Wave 3 (w3-coreaudiokit, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No Audio Unit host and no plugin view controller. The DAW plugins are an in-house instrument/effect format with built-in device UIs. The generic ViewController in springboard/sdk/src/view/app.rs is not audio-specific. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 4 (0.5.41); verify on Midget for parity.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 9 tests. Wave 3 (w3-coreaudiokit, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No panner unit or specialised panner UI.

features.feature: Bluetooth MIDI peripheral picker and advertising
features.note: Wave 5 (theme-04, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The Bluetooth module lists audio profiles (A2DP sink/source, headset) and has no MIDI service UUID handling or BLE MIDI peripheral. Bluetooth audio streaming itself is out of the module (bluetooth.rs:18).

features.bifrost: springboard/src/deildu/mod.rs (LAN stream URL for the TV), springboard/src/media/route.rs (route display)
features.note: No browser for network audio devices and no SDK API for one. The LAN stream server serves a download to the TV, not a device picker.

features.feature: Audio route indicator for connected devices
features.apple: Route picker shown with now playing (CoreAudioKit does not supply it; listed for context)
features.note: Shows the connected Bluetooth audio device name in Now Playing. It is not a reusable SDK route picker for apps.

features.feature: Audio playback service shared by apps
features.apple: Not part of CoreAudioKit (AVFoundation and Core Audio); listed because CoreAudioKit device views depend on it
features.note: Service owns the speaker and microphone; apps reach it over the service socket. The SDK has no audio API of its own (springboard/sdk/src/lib.rs has no audio module).
Lists iOS devices that support inter-device audio. Apple-device-only feature with no BifrOSt counterpart.

features.feature: Inter-App Audio switcher and transport views
features.note: Deprecated in iOS 13 and unavailable for iPad apps on macOS per the Apple page.
Deprecated Apple internals with no BifrOSt counterpart.

gaps: No Audio Unit host: BifrOSt cannot load third-party AU plugins or show their custom views (AUViewController, AUAudioUnitViewConfiguration).
No generic audio unit view (AUGenericView) or panner view (AUPannerView) for plugins without a custom UI.
No BLE MIDI peripheral picker or local MIDI peripheral advertising (CABTMIDI* equivalents).
No network audio device browser (CANetworkBrowserWindowController equivalent) and no SDK route picker for apps.
Bluetooth audio streaming (A2DP/AVDTP) is not handled in springboard/src/bare/bluetooth.rs, so a device picker would list devices that cannot carry audio yet.
